skill.descEnRank5:
Basic Attack
Deal Spectro DMG equal to 200.00% of the active Resonator's ATK.
 
Core Skill
Transform into Jinhsi Cube and cast Light Beam to bombard the front area for 5s, dealing Spectro DMG equal to 1349.36% of the active Resonator's ATK per second. Skill Cooldown: 12s.
- Jinhsi Cube can control the direction of the Light Beam.
 
Enhanced Effect
Skill Projectiles Level 2/4: The number of Light Beam is increased by 1/2.
Skill Duration Level 2/4/6/8: The skill duration is increased by 2/4/6/8s.
